summary: Jindal Steel reported record Q2 FY27 gross revenue of INR 19,438 crore; net revenue rose 43% YoY to INR 16,704 crore, EBITDA up 34% to INR 2,504 crore.
Stock fell 2.22% to $1,014 as profit after tax declined to INR 771 crore from INR 844 crore prior quarter amid rising raw material and freight costs.
Net debt reduced by INR 1,141 crore; debt-to-EBITDA improved to 1.51x from 1.71x, with cash reserves at INR 7,237 crore strengthening balance sheet.
Management targets 11M tons steel production for FY27; new slurry pipeline to save INR 700/ton, 2M-ton DRI plant and gasifiers due June 2027.
Company shifting product mix to 65% flat products from 60%, targeting INR 1 lakh crore annual sales amid expected Q3 coking coal cost increases.
